metadata.title: MPAS quasi-uniform x1.2562 — unit sphere (N=2562 cells)
metadata.description: MPAS Voronoi mesh with 2562 cells, unit sphere R=1. Used for Layer-C MMS time-integration convergence tests where the diffusion timescale R^2 must be O(1) so that t_final=0.001 produces a measurable solution change. Grid topology is the Voronoi dual of DUO icosahedral subdivision level 4.
